description: Build a small async workflow orchestrator with dependency scheduling, retries, failure propagation, validation, and Markdown reporting.

measurement.claim: Agentflow should match or beat direct Codex on a long-running, multi-concern implementation task when Agentflow receives a best-practice graph and direct Codex receives the same detailed task plan as a plain prompt.
expected_failure_modes: the implementation misses dependency ordering, validation, retry, skip, or reporting behavior
the final validation command fails or is not captured
workspace changes are missing, forbidden, or out of scope
handoff evidence is missing, stale, or too vague to audit
Agentflow underperforms the direct Codex baseline on deterministic or quality evidence
Agentflow prompt surfaces leak graph mechanics or add avoidable context noise
measurement.tweak_signal: Inspect Agentflow versus direct Codex deltas, final validation behavior, item-level evidence, prompt diagnostics, scope control, and handoff quality before changing prompt packs or managed-pattern behavior.
